changelog: v0.8.1: 1) Avatar Switching & Kinematic Persistence: Fixed gesture breakdown across avatar transitions by resolving async GLB race conditions, implementing deep skeleton remap cloning, and preventing mixer stomping on procedural gestures; 2) In-VR 3D Console Fixes: Fixed 3D avatar disappearing in WebXR during panel cycling with atomic AppState sync and immediate grounding transform; 3) Transparent Passthrough WebXR: Fixed black screen backdrop in Mixed Reality Passthrough by enforcing true WebGL canvas alpha transparency and null scene background; 4) Modular Architecture: Decoupled rig bone data from motion kinematics into js/avatars/motion.js; 5) Gentle Ambient Background Music: Added 8 continuous procedural ambient music soundscapes with comfortable background volume, automatic track progression cycling, single-track looping, speech ducking, and In-VR HUD console controls.
